testName: Integration Procedure (IP) Orchestration & External REST Callout
steps:
1. In OmniStudio Designer, open Integration Procedure "IP_GetCreditRatingAndCreditLimit"
2. Click on "Preview" tab
3. Enter Input JSON: {"AccountId": "001xxxxxxxxxxxx", "TaxId": "12-3456789"}
4. Click "Execute" button
5. In Execution Log, verify Step 1 (DataRaptor Extract) pulls Account details
6. Verify Step 2 (HTTP Action) calls external Experian credit scoring REST API
7. Verify Step 3 (DataRaptor Transform) blends external credit score with CRM history
8. Verify Output JSON contains calculated CreditLimit: $75,000 and Status: "Approved"
